name: My content makes sense
goal: Everything that arrives tells me at a glance what kind of thing it is, who it is with and what it is about, grouped the way I think of it and newest first
done: With real-shaped mail and calendar arrived, Messages shows them in sections by kind (From people first, then Invitations, Updates and the rest), newest first in each, and every row names who it is with or what it is about

measure.says: share of arrived items labeled with the kind a person would give them
